name: Squire
backstory: Prior to becoming undead, Squire was the Thorm family dog. She died the same night as Isobel while trying to protect her, an event she now only vaguely remembers. As part of Ketheric's desperate alliance with Myrkul to restore his lost family, he also revived Squire.
